purpose: Teach: ロク/オンリー/゛/トロツキー/健太郎/二郎/ロビン/みずほ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、毎朝ロク、つまり六時から朝礼を始められた
lines.en: When you were young, Dad, you always started the morning meetings at six o'clock sharp.
lines.style: Gentle, measured reminiscence. Unhurried pace. Soft opening—a man settling into memory. Slight warmth on the detail of the time, as if that precision matters. Voice carries the weight of years of respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはオンリーワン経営の理念を貫かれた
lines.en: Yes. Father held fast to the principle of being one of a kind in management.
lines.style: Careful affirmation. Respectful, formal register—a son speaking of his father with precision. Steady breath. Slight pause before 'one of a kind'—honoring the concept. Grounded, not effusive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、文書の濁点、つまり゛にも細心の注意を払われた
lines.en: Dad, he was meticulous about every detail—even the small marks in documents.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering tone. The voice of someone marveling at a discipline he's inherited but still learning to match. Slight fadeout on 'detail.' Quiet affection beneath the observation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは若い頃、トロツキー時代のロシア経済の論文を読まれた
lines.en: Yes. In his younger days, Father read deeply into Russian economic theory—even Trotskyist works.
lines.style: Thoughtful, unhurried. Speaks like he's connecting a thread across decades. Warmth in the intellectual reference—pride in his father's rigor. Slight pause before the historical reference, as if weighing its significance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、健太郎社員を熱心に育てられた
lines.en: Dad, when he was young, he mentored Kentaro with real dedication.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost wondering. Pace slows slightly—the voice of someone recognizing a pattern in his father's character. Soft on 'dedication'—not stating it flatly, but discovering it afresh.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは二郎社員、現二郎部長をご贔屓だった
lines.en: Yes. Father took Jiro under his wing—he's the director now, as you know.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm beneath. The tone of noting a cause and its effect across time. Slight weight on 'now'—acknowledging the continuity. Steady, respectful formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、海外ロビン氏との合弁を成功された
lines.en: Dad, in his younger days, he successfully built a joint venture with a partner overseas.
lines.style: Measured, admiring tone. Voice carries the quiet pride of someone recounting a concrete achievement. Steady pace. Slight lift on 'successfully'—not boastful, but clear-eyed about what was done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはみずほ銀行と長年取引された
lines.en: Yes. Father maintained a long relationship with Mizuho Bank—decades of trust.
lines.style: Quiet, weighty conclusion. The voice settles into finality—this is a summation. Slow, deliberate pace. Warmth in 'trust,' though understated. The cadence of a man honoring what has lasted.
